title: Hal & Mal's
venue_description:
About Hal & Mal's

Hal & Mal's is a Jackson landmark that has been serving the community since 1985. Founded by brothers Hal and Malcolm White this iconic venue occupies a historic GM&O freight depot building in downtown Jackson. The establishment seamlessly blends the roles of restaurant bar and live music venue creating a vibrant gathering place for locals and visitors alike.

Multiple Performance Spaces

Hal & Mal's features several distinct music venues within its walls. The Red Room hosts local regional and national touring acts with ticketed shows throughout the week. The Dining Room provides an intimate setting for regular performances including Tuesday Night Jazz and various acoustic acts. The Big Room accommodates larger events and concerts. The venue also includes a Brew Pub and The Walk-In space for additional entertainment options.

Regular Music Programming

The venue hosts an impressive array of weekly recurring events. Blue Monday takes place every Monday night in the Red Room featuring the Central Mississippi Blues Society's jam session from 7-11 PM. Tuesday nights bring jazz with the Raphael Semmes Quartet in the Dining Room. Select Fridays feature bluegrass nights. Karaoke runs Monday nights in The Walk-In. The venue also hosts weekly trivia nights.

Cuisine and Atmosphere

The restaurant serves Gulf Coast-centric cuisine with a menu that includes seafood gumbo red beans and rice po-boys hand-patted burgers and fresh seafood dishes like the Redfish Pearl and Vancleave Po-boy. Happy hour runs Monday through Saturday from 4-6:30 PM. The interior is filled with photographs posters and memorabilia celebrating Jackson's cultural heritage.

History and Legacy

After the passing of co-founder Hal White in 2013 the venue continued under Malcolm White's stewardship. In 2022 ownership transitioned to Damien Cavicchi and Mary Sanders Ferriss Cavicchi who also own Campbell's Bakery with Malcolm remaining involved. The venue supports approximately 12 families and employs staff members who have been with the establishment for 10 15 and even 20 years.

Special Events

Hal & Mal's serves as the official afterparty location for Hal's St. Paddy's Parade one of Jackson's biggest annual celebrations. The venue hosts the New Year's Eve Catfish Ball and numerous other special events throughout the year.

title: Duling Hall
venue_description:
About Duling Hall

Duling Hall is an architectural gem located at the center of the Fondren neighborhood in Jackson Mississippi. Built in 1928 as an elementary school this historic venue has been transformed into an award-winning live music and events space that combines unique character with modern acoustics and professional production capabilities.

The Venue

The hall features stained glass windows and distinctive architectural details that reflect its rich history. The intimate venue provides mighty acoustics making it ideal for a wide variety of musical performances from folk and bluegrass to rock and indie acts. The venue capacity allows for an up-close concert experience while maintaining professional sound and lighting systems.

Music Programming

Duling Hall hosts an impressive roster of local regional and national touring artists. Past performers have included Drive-By Truckers Leftover Salmon The Flaming Lips Blind Boys of Alabama Leon Russell Taj Mahal and many others. The venue showcases diverse genres including Americana rock jazz folk and more. Regular events include The Writers' Round songwriter nights and various tribute performances.

Professional Services

Every event at Duling Hall includes a professional audio/visual technician to operate the PA and sound system. The venue offers a full bar staffed by partners from Saltine restaurant. While the venue has preferred caterers clients are not locked into specific vendors allowing for customizable event planning.

Accessibility and Parking

Ample parking is available at the north and south entrances of the venue. A wheelchair-accessible entrance is located on the north side. The venue is within walking distance of multiple upscale Fondren restaurants and shops.

Private Events

Beyond concerts Duling Hall serves as a premier event space for weddings rehearsal dinners corporate events conferences training sessions and private celebrations. The flexible space can accommodate various budgets and event types with customizable packages available.

title: Soulé Coffee and Bubble Tea
venue_description:
About Soulé Coffee

Soulé Coffee and Bubble Tea is a modern coffee shop and community space located in the heart of the Fondren neighborhood. Founded in 2017 by musician and entrepreneur Ezra Brown this is the third brick-and-mortar location of Soulé bringing global flavors and community-focused programming to Jackson Mississippi.

The Vision

Ezra Brown a South Carolina native who calls Jackson his second hometown created Soulé based on his experiences touring internationally as a musician. He studied at Jackson State University where he developed the Count Basie jazz style and formed lifelong connections. His travels to places like Malaysia Singapore and Switzerland inspired him to create a cafe that serves as more than just a coffee shop—it's a space for community inspiration and collaboration.

Menu and Offerings

Soulé offers crafted bubble teas refreshers espresso drinks matcha beverages and a variety of teas. The menu celebrates global flavors with influences from cultures around the world. Popular items include their espresso drinks matcha beverages and bubble tea lemonades. The shop operates with a modern tech-forward approach featuring self-serve cashless checkout kiosks.

Music and Events

The venue hosts monthly Open Mic + Band nights where performers can showcase their talents backed by a full live band. This unique format provides musicians with professional accompaniment creating a special performance opportunity. The venue also serves as home to the JXN Artists Business Meetup providing a think tank space for local artists to collaborate and develop their business skills.

Community Impact

Soulé aims to be a change agent for young creators in Mississippi. The space provides free WiFi comfortable seating and an atmosphere conducive to creativity and entrepreneurship. Future programming includes business development resources and community events that support local artists and makers.

Hours and Atmosphere

Open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM Soulé offers both delivery and take-out options. The space is designed to foster the same sense of community and possibility that Ezra experienced in cafes around the world—a place where stories are shared connections are made and dreams take shape.

title: Martin's Downtown
venue_description:
About Martin's Downtown

Martin's Downtown has been a cornerstone of Jackson's nightlife and music scene since 1953. This downtown Jackson establishment seamlessly combines the roles of restaurant bar and live music venue creating a vibrant gathering place that draws both locals and tourists with its eclectic atmosphere and commitment to showcasing talent.

The Venue

Located at 214 South State Street Martin's Downtown features a back-room stage that serves as the focal point for live entertainment. The interior is adorned with memorabilia reflecting the rich musical heritage of the Mississippi region. The venue offers both indoor seating and outdoor patio space for guests to enjoy.

Live Music Programming

Martin's Downtown regularly hosts performances from local singers to touring acts throughout the week. The venue has featured diverse genres including rock blues jam bands electronic music tribute acts and more. Notable performers have included Kirkos The Hooten Hallers Grateful Dead tributes The Warped Band (Warped Tour tribute) and various electronic music showcases.

Music Genres and Events

The venue embraces musical diversity with performances spanning rock country blues jazz fusion post-rock electronic music and experimental genres. Special event series include Electronically Speaking featuring DJs and producers and various themed tribute nights. The venue also hosts Dixie National Rodeo aftershows and other special events throughout the year.

Food and Drink

Martin's offers a classic Southern menu with daily blue-plate specials including pork chops fried chicken meatloaf pot roast and traditional sides. The full dinner menu features burgers po-boys seafood and more. The restaurant also offers a full bar with local craft beers and nightly drink specials. Late-night food service is available.

Hours and Atmosphere

Open Monday through Saturday from 11:00 AM to 2:00 AM and Sunday from 10:00 AM to midnight Martin's Downtown accommodates both casual diners and late-night revelers. The venue is known for its welcoming atmosphere that encourages dancing live music appreciation and social gathering. Good for groups with both takeout and dine-in options available.
